findings.message: "OK" says nothing about the action. A button is a verb plus a noun, for example "Save board".
"Close" is one word. A button is a verb plus a noun, for example "Delete board".
marginLeft is physical and does not mirror in RTL. Use marginInlineStart.
textAlign: 'left' is physical. Use 'start'.
right is physical and does not mirror in RTL. Use insetInlineEnd.
margin-left is physical. Use margin-inline-start.

; } ". Use a comma, colon, period or parentheses.
<span title>: native title attribute. Use the Tooltip component (WCAG 1.4.13).
Import from radix-ui in app code. Use the system component from @the-system/react; it wires the behavior, the anatomy and the tokens.
Import from @radix-ui/react-popover in app code. Use the system component from @the-system/react; it wires the behavior, the anatomy and the tokens.
color: #ff0000 is a raw color. Use a --ds-color-* token.
padding: 12px is a raw length. Use a --ds-* token.
<button> where the system has Button. Use Button. Instead use: IconButton (only an icon); Link (navigation inside text).
<input> where the system has Input. Use Input. Instead use: Textarea (text longer than one line); Select (a choice from a short known list).
<dialog> where the system has Dialog. Use Dialog. Instead use: Drawer (long content); Toast (no decision).
Button tone="primary" is not a value of the manifest. Use one of: neutral, accent, danger, success, warning, info.
Input shape="square" is not a value of the manifest. Use one of: default, pill.
DialogFooter holds 4 items; the Dialog footer slot takes at most 3. Instead use: Drawer (long content); Toast (no decision).
<div> in the Dialog footer slot, which takes Button. Instead use: Drawer (long content); Toast (no decision).
Button start takes Icon, not <span>. Instead use: IconButton (only an icon); Link (navigation inside text).
--ds-color-text-made-up is not in the token build and this file does not declare it. Use a token from packages/tokens or add the name to packages/tokens/src/contract.json.
Button size="xs" is 24px, under the 44pt (iOS) and 48dp (Android) touch target. Use sm or larger in a touch template.
